title: Better Health Indicator [BHI]
description: Advanced PvP Health Indicator for Fabric featuring target health display, ping display, damage indicators, heal indicators, HUD editor and full customization. 🚀
body:
# ❤️ Better Health Indicator

> Advanced PvP Health Indicator for Fabric 1.21.11 featuring Target Health Display, Ping Display, Damage Indicators, Heal Indicators, HUD Editor, Range Control and Full Customization.

---

## ⚔️ Overview

Better Health Indicator is a modern PvP-focused utility mod designed to provide essential combat information directly on your screen.

Track player health in real time, monitor ping, visualize damage and healing events, and fully customize your HUD to match your gameplay style.

Whether you're playing Lifesteal SMP, Survival SMP, Crystal PvP, Practice PvP, or Competitive Multiplayer, Better Health Indicator gives you the information you need without cluttering your screen.

Built with performance and customization in mind, the mod remains lightweight while offering a rich feature set.

---

# ✨ Features

## ❤️ Real-Time Target Health Display

Quickly view the health of the player you're looking at.

✔ Heart-Based Health Display

✔ Numerical Health Display

✔ Live Health Updates

✔ Smooth Rendering

✔ Multiplayer Support

✔ Clean PvP-Friendly Design

View player latency directly in the HUD.

✔ Real-Time Ping Information
